# Sun: a 16-sided disc 3 m across facing the camera (only its front face), rising behind the far
# bank. Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sun --base-color 0.9765 0.8510 0.3333 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Sun --vertices 16 --radius 1.5 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Sun
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export sun.glb
